main_text.p: hæc quorundam objectio. Ex ipsiusmet verbis Apostoli, Capite 11, versu 3. Ἥτις[?] (σωτηρίας) ἀρχὴν λαβοῦσα λαλεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τοῦ Κυ-[?] ρίου, ὑπὸ τῶν ἀκουσάντων εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐβεβαιώθη.[?] Quibus, referre se inter discipulos Apostolorum videtur Author. Profiteri ab iis se edoctum, atq; confirmatum. Non ipsummet vidisse se vel audivisse, sed ab iis qui viderunt & audiverunt, accepisse. Adeóque nec Paulum scriptorem esse, nec Apostolorum quemquam. Quorum fuit immediata revelatio; qui testes oculares & auriti simul; qui non ab hominibus, sed à Christo ipso, de omnibus plenissimè instructi; qui Magistri ipsi, non discipuli; aut discipuli Christi, non ullius Apostoli.

II. Non meminère objectionis, quantùm constat, vetustissimi Patrum. Benè meminit Oecumenius, in Præfatione Commentarij, aliique ex posterioribus. Avidè arripuére in causæ suæ subsidium, recentiorum multi. Et torsit ex primis Calvinus, Commentario ad locum: Cæterùm hic locus indicio est, Epistolam non fuisse à Paulo compositam, neque enim tam
[The line "humi-" is the catchword, not text.]

page.notes: The Greek on the page (Ἥτις ... ἐβεβαιώθη) is read from a small, blurred print; the letters are approximate and marked [?] where doubtful. The line of the Greek with "Κυ-" and "ρίου" is hyphenated across the line end as printed. The word "Qui-" / "bus" is hyphenated across the Greek line. The reference mark before "Apostolorum" (a curved bracket above the line) is not clearly legible and is not transcribed. The spelling "meminère" and "non" may carry diacritics that are hard to see at this resolution. The "Y" at the foot is the gathering signature; "huni-" is the catchword.
